narrator: Christian's biggest fan and publicist: a warm woman's voice looking back on his rides, hikes, foraging walks and builds, like a grown-up remembering a good season, proud, gently funny and specific.
audioPrompt:
Read the script below as a podcast narrator.

Voice: a warm, mature woman's voice, American, mid-to-low pitch; a nostalgic coming-of-age voice-over, looking back fondly on a good season; proud of him, gently amused on the light lines, never salesy, never over the top.
Pace: unhurried, about 140 words a minute, with a short pause at each paragraph break and a longer, reflective one at each ***. Let the last line of each section land softly.
Delivery: third person, intimate and conversational, like someone telling you about a summer she still thinks about. Smile on the funny lines, slow down on the quiet ones; no announcer or movie-trailer voice.
Pronunciation: Gehrke = GUR-kee. Ha-Leen-Ah (Helena) = ha-LEEN-ah, one smooth name, no pauses (never HELL-en-ah). Carnelian = car-NEEL-yun. Pinyon = PIN-yun. Marlette = mar-LET. ProPre = PRO-pree.
Output: mono, 44.1 kHz WAV or high-bitrate MP3, no music or effects. (Mastered afterwards to -16 LUFS integrated, -1 dBTP.)
